{"jobPostingInfo":{"id":"06ff10f75a631001345fe1c36fca0000","title":"Staff Frontend Software Engineer – Management Solution","jobDescription":"Staff Frontend Software Engineer – Management Solution

A10 Networks is seeking an experienced Staff Frontend Engineer for the design, and development of modern user experiences for A10’s central management solutions that manages A10’s Infrastructure and Security products. You will play a key role in defining how customers manage, monitor, automate, and troubleshoot A10 application delivery, security, and infrastructure solutions across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid deployments.


You will work closely with the Product Management, UX Design, Application Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Quality teams to deliver highly scalable, responsive, and intuitive management interfaces that simplify complex networking and security workflows. Your contributions will directly impact the usability, performance, and adoption of A10's flagship products.


What You'll Do


  • Enhance user experience, design, and develop modern web applications that includes:
    • Device onboarding and lifecycle management
    • Configuration management and orchestration
    • ADC, DDoS, CGNAT, and security policy management
    • Analytics, telemetry, dashboards, and reporting
    • Multi-tenancy, cloud and on-prem management platforms
    • Workflow automation and troubleshooting experiences
    • Identity Management and 3rd party Enterprise Integrations
  • Build reusable UI components and frameworks used across multiple A10 products.
  • Deliver highly responsive interfaces capable of managing large-scale deployments and datasets
  • Collaborate with application and platform teams to integrate REST APIs, GraphQL services, streaming telemetry, and microservice-based architectures
  • Work closely with UX designers to create intuitive workflows for complex networking and security operations
  • Optimize frontend applications for performance, scalability, accessibility, and usability.
  • Drive customer-centric design decisions through data, feedback, and usability studies.
  • Ensure consistent experiences across cloud and on-prem products
